categories.label: Testing
categories.note: Driven by the test-to-code ratio, minus CI/coverage penalties.

findings.title: 16 functions exceed cyclomatic complexity 15
findings.detail:
Cyclomatic complexity approximated from branch points (if/loops/case/&&/||/ternaries). Top offenders:
• `validate10` (cx=426) — lib/config-validator.js:10
• `buildRouting` (cx=98) — lib/route.js:76
• `route` (cx=82) — lib/route.js:203
• `lowerCaseHeadersSchema` (cx=45) — lib/validation.js:73
• `addNewRoute` (cx=33) — lib/route.js:274

findings.title: 23 files over 800 lines

findings.title: Deep nesting in 12 functions (more than 5 levels)
findings.detail:
• `validate10` (depth≈40) — lib/config-validator.js:10
• `buildRouting` (depth≈9) — lib/route.js:76
• `route` (depth≈8) — lib/route.js:203
• `addNewRoute` (depth≈7) — lib/route.js:274
• `normalizeSchema` (depth≈6) — lib/schemas.js:58
Deep nesting usually hides a missing early-return or guard clause.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential-like assignment (3 locations)
findings.detail:
• test/schema-serialization.test.js:1231 (`SHOULD…`)
• test/schema-serialization.test.js:1267 (`SHOULD…`)

findings.title: No lockfile committed
findings.detail: package.json exists but no package-lock.json / yarn.lock / pnpm-lock.yaml. Installs are not reproducible and dependency updates are unauditable.

findings.title: Almost no docstrings/JSDoc (0% of 917 functions)
findings.detail: Document public functions at minimum — the exported API surface.

findings.title: 1 very large directory (≥50 source files)
findings.detail:
• test/ (137 files)
Group by feature/domain instead of dumping everything together.

findings.title: 1 circular module dependency detected
findings.detail:
• lib → (root) → lib
Cycles make modules untestable in isolation — break them by extracting a shared lower-level module.

plan.title: Move hardcoded credentials out of source
plan.detail: Replace with environment variables, then rotate each value — it is already in history.

plan.title: Refactor the highest-complexity functions
plan.detail: Start with the top 5 offenders: extract helpers, replace branch chains with early returns and lookup tables. Target cx ≤ 10 per function.

plan.title: Commit a lockfile
plan.detail: Commit package-lock.json / yarn.lock / pnpm-lock.yaml so installs are reproducible and auditable.

plan.title: Flatten deeply nested code
plan.detail: Introduce guard clauses/early returns and invert conditions — nesting beyond 4 levels hides logic bugs.

plan.title: Split god files into focused modules
plan.detail: Group by responsibility (parsing, IO, orchestration) and extract classes/modules; keep files under ~300 lines.

plan.title: Extract shared helpers from duplicated blocks
plan.detail: The flagged clones drift apart silently — consolidate each group into one function.

plan.title: Break circular module dependencies
plan.detail: 1 cycle(s) detected in the module graph — extract shared lower-level modules until dependencies form a DAG.

plan.title: Adopt a docstring/JSDoc convention
plan.detail: Document all exported functions first; enforce with eslint-plugin-jsdoc / ruff pydocstyle.

plan.title: Reorganize oversized directories
plan.detail: Group files by feature/domain to restore navigability.

notes: Partial analysis: 389 of 391 files were analyzed (size/file-count caps). Scores are still representative but not exhaustive.
⚠ Exposed secrets detected — rotate them and purge git history, not just the latest commit.
270 imports could not be resolved to local files — the architecture graph may be incomplete.
